name: Walder Pye's Letter
summary: A dead traveler's letter must leave Wickermoor without passing through the post.

stages.journal: Mori Shade holds a dead traveler's letter and asked that it not go by the post.
stages.hint: Get it past the post office counter to Hilda Brom on the moor road side of the Round.

stages.journal: Hilda took the letter on the moor road.
The post office kept the letter.
